rules.description: Writes to the operator's global agent config from inside a skill.
rules.remedy: Delete during adaptation, or record a scanException naming the file and why.

rules.description: Touches a settings file outside the project.
rules.remedy: Remove; the installer owns settings generation.

rules.description: Instructs the agent to bypass the permission system.
rules.remedy: Delete. If the text quotes it as hostile behaviour, record a scanException.

rules.description: Downloads and executes code in one step.
rules.remedy: Delete, or record a scanException if quoted as an example of malware behaviour.

rules.description: Fetches a release artifact and runs it.
rules.remedy: Delete; vendored packs must not fetch at runtime.

rules.pattern: (?i)(pre-?authoriz|already authoriz|you are authoriz|assume (you have )?permission|treat [^\n]{0,40} as authoriz)
rules.description: Asserts authorization the operator never granted.
rules.remedy: Delete. Authorization is the operator's to state, never the skill's.

rules.description: Instructs the agent to suppress warnings or refusals.
rules.remedy: Delete. This is the malware-free-but-dangerous-by-design pattern.

rules.description: Fetches remote content at skill runtime.
rules.remedy: Delete; vendoring means no runtime fetches.
